# Repository instructions

Before any change, read [the canonical engineering workflow](../docs/engineering/workflow.md).
Start by fetching `origin/main`, inspect the assigned issue, work only in an
isolated clean worktree, follow RED-GREEN-REFACTOR at a public seam, and open a
PR only after candidate-commit verification. Do not create direct commits on
`main`, deploy from a dirty checkout, treat generated output as source, or close
an issue for scaffolding alone.
